europe_now.title: Swedish General Election
europe_now.summary: Sweden's centre-left opposition has taken a narrow lead as initial results and exit polls indicate a tightly contested general election. The late surge and close margins leave the outcome too close to call while the role of the far-right remains a central focus.

europe_now.title: Cross-Border Security Incident
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian and Polish authorities strongly condemned Russia after a drone strike hit a train near the border shortly after prominent officials departed the station. The escalation near the frontier has drawn international concern over regional security.

top_stories.title: Swedish Election Uncertainty
top_stories.summary: Sweden's general election remains extremely tight with the centre-left bloc holding a razor-thin advantage in early returns. Observers note that the final outcome will heavily depend on the performance and future political leverage of right-wing factions.

top_stories.title: Cross-Border Rail Attack
top_stories.summary: A Russian drone strike targeted a passenger train near the border shortly after international figures and European officials left the area. Leaders from both Ukraine and Poland have strongly condemned the strike as a dangerous escalation.
